name: Fenlow Post 3 Original
description: This listing is a firn-sealed grain locker listed with chamber depth 10 metres, holding temperature -4 degrees Celsius, stored unit capacity 1075 units. Its remaining stated figures are retrieval time 18 minutes, annual fee set after acceptance, open months 9 months. Every one of them is quoted from the same six axes the other listings in this category are described on.
